subject: reasoning
question: A person walks 4 km north, then 3 km east, and finally 4 km south. In which direction is he from his starting point?
solution:
Given: A person walks 4 km north,

Then 3 km east,

And finally, 4 km south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426c595f1e3fd6b2378998ccbd55ddfcd525eb483aac7c2ed6332d07d11d5004.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19e61bf8316243d3c78b3ab78e6710077101e7922dd1ebce42d2aaccafde3f80.png] 

So, he is east of his starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
